messages:
maya_cs: Quick sync — Syzygy's onboarding test this morning showed 2s tail latency for long prompts during peak (50 concurrent reqs). Their SLA/workload is very latency-sensitive and they're starting a renewal conversation next quarter. I want to propose a low-risk, staged plan: canary quantize to int8 on a subset of traffic, add region-aware routing to push low-latency traffic to us-east-1 pool, and enable prefix KV caching for their common prompt templates.

ben_eng: +1 on staged canary. Do we have a ready int8 build for the model they're using (rw-compat-1.2)?

sam_sre: We do have a verified int8 variant: rw-compat-1.2-int8-alpha. Perf numbers look good in internal perfbench for 1280 tokens, tail p95 drops ~30%. Need to watch for a small drop in rare long-form quality checks.

maya_cs: Good — my plan: 1) Canary 5% traffic to rw-compat-1.2-int8-alpha for 24h, 2) Monitor quality evals (sampled sys prompts), 3) If no regressions, ramp to 40% and enable route by latency for eu traffic to eu-west-1 fallback pool, 4) If stable after 72h, flip default model and keep int8 as primary.

phil_pm: Sounds reasonable. What's the rollback plan if we see quality regressions? Also customer enablement: we should schedule a short walkthrough with Syzygy's ML lead so they know what to expect.

ben_eng: Rollback = immediate: revert canary traffic to rw-compat-1.2 and promote cached tokens flush. I can add a feature flag for the canary so we can kill within seconds. I'll also add an automated diff eval job that runs on the sampled outputs and posts alerts if quality metric delta > 2% on our prompt set.

maya_cs: I'll own scheduling the enablement call; want to set expectations around potential tiny answer style drift and how we'll surface it. Sam, can you add the routing rule and KV caching toggle?

sam_sre: Yep. Adding a route policy that pins low-latency traffic to the dedicated east pool and a prefix-KV cache for their top 20 templates. Config snippet I'm about to push:

```
# route policy (yaml)
match:
  - header: x-client-id
    equals: syzygy
actions:
  - type: route_by_latency
    regions: [us-east-1, eu-west-1]
    fallback: us-east-1-dedicated
  - type: enable_kv_cache
    prefixes: ["invoice_summary_v2", "reply_short_form_*"]
```

maya_cs: Nice. Can we also make the canary window a bit longer for their busiest hours? Their traffic spikes 09:00-11:00 PST.

ben_eng: I'll schedule the canary rollout to avoid the spike for the first 24h, then re-evaluate during the spike window on day 2. Also enabling tracing so we can correlate any user complaints to specific tokens.

ops-bot: [alert] perf-monitor: syzygy peak qps 48.3, p95 latency 2.03s, kv_cache_hit_rate 0%.

maya_cs: Thanks — ops-bot data aligns. My next steps: 1) Book enablement + expectations call with Syzygy (CC ML lead), 2) Send proposed canary schedule to Syzygy PM with rollback language, 3) Share monitoring dashboard and eval diff thresholds. ben_eng/sam_sre: ping me when feature flag + route policy are deployed.

phil_pm: I'll capture this plan in the renewal playbook and flag as a potential pre-renewal value add (cost/perf wins).

ben_eng: Feature flag and diff-eval job created. Pushed canary config to staging. Link: https://console.redwood.internal/canaries/3123456789

maya_cs: Perfect. I'll coordinate the customer meeting for tomorrow 10:30 PST and post meeting notes here. :thumbsup:

sam_sre: If the int8 variant shows >1% quality delta on the sampled prompts, we'll auto-hold the ramp and ping this thread.

maya_cs: Agreed. Thanks team.
